Which proportion must be true?
visual_elements: Two quadrilaterals PQRT and KLMN are shown with side lengths and angles marked. PQRT has sides labeled x ft, 4.28 ft, 4.12 ft, and 3 ft. KLMN has sides labeled 9 ft, 8.91 ft, 12.84 ft, and y ft.
